$comment: Gates on accepted work, by facts only. keepDays: how long covered ACCEPTs, DONEs and pushes stay; openMost: open ACCEPTs kept at most, the oldest dropped first. turnEntries: history entries read for the accepting turn. acceptsRead, filesRead, headsRead, pushesRead, uncoveredShown: bounds on what one gate reads or names. waive: an ACCEPT line that keeps a blocking finding, of the hand-in or of a review. reviewsRead: the REVIEWs since the hand-in read for P0 and P1 findings on the head handed in; reviewLineChars: how much of a finding's line is named. rules: each gap's line.

rules.unread: the room could not read {turn}, so no run of {command} is seen
rules.unhanded: no hand-in of this work with its commit is on record
rules.unreadWork: the room could not read the work as it stands
rules.changed: the work changed after it was handed in
rules.unwaived: blocking finding(s) of the hand-in not waived: {findings}; name each in the ACCEPT as `waive <id>: <why it may stay>`
rules.unweighed: review finding(s) on this head not waived: {findings}; repair it, or name each in the ACCEPT as `waive <id>: <why it may stay>`
rules.unreadHead: the room could not read HEAD
rules.many: only the first {n} accepted tasks were read
rules.missing: task {task}: its accepted head {head} is not in HEAD
rules.untold: task {task}: the room could not tell whether HEAD holds its accepted head {head} as accepted
rules.altered: task {task} reopens: {files} changed after its ACCEPT
rules.temporary: a `TEMPORARY` line names no open issue that removes it: {items}
